provenance: Both VIs newly authored in LabVIEW 2020; the leaf was created by selecting the explicit strict Numeric Property Node and using Edit > Create SubVI. No application VI or NI sample was copied.

semantics.description: Write the supplied U32 to the referenced Numeric control, then read Value from the same control. Return the written value; the target must hold that value.
semantics.boundary: Generate and execute the leaf with an explicit Python attribute adapter. The native harness supplies a genuine control reference. This does not implement VI Server, implicit control references, reference constants or hardware drivers.
semantics.comparison: Exact U32 result and target state; numeric input unchanged; Python adapter events must be write then read.
